backend.description: Voice system: Automatic picks the server voice channels when the server has them (Enhanced), else Mumble. A change applies when ai-voice starts again.

distance.description: Distance: How far this range carries, in metres.

defaultMode.description: Starting range: The position in the list a player starts with (1 = the first range).

cycle.description: Players can change their range: Off keeps everyone at the starting range (scripts can still change it).

rangeFactor.description: Mumble reach factor: FiveM Legacy only: players within the range times this number receive the voice (Mumble's native audio fades out over a longer distance than the range). 3 is pma-voice's value.

radioVolume.description: Radio volume: How loud others sound, in percent; players can change it for themselves.

maxRadioChannels.description: Frequencies at once: How many frequencies a player can listen to at the same time; they talk on one of them.

radioAnim.description: Radio animation on: Off: no animation on any frequency. Scripts can also turn it off for one player.

radioAnimSet.description: Animation: Used on every frequency without its own animation.

radioAnimFlag.description: Animation flag: TaskPlayAnim flag: 49 = upper body, loops, can walk; 50 = upper body, holds the last frame, can walk.

radioSubmix.description: Radio sound effect: Filters the voice like a speaker. The game has a small fixed number of sound effects and cannot remove one: switching this off stops using the effect, players free its slot only by restarting the game. On FiveM Enhanced this needs setr sv_mumble true.

micClicks.description: Radio clicks: A click when someone starts and stops talking on the radio; players can turn it off for themselves.

syncNames.description: Send names to radio members: Radio scripts that list members get each member's character name.

phoneVolume.description: Call volume: How loud others sound, in percent; players can change it for themselves.

phoneSubmix.description: Phone sound effect: Filters call voices like a phone. Switch it off when your phone script brings its own call effect (lb-phone with CallEffects is not detected). Players free the effect's slot only by restarting the game. On FiveM Enhanced this needs setr sv_mumble true.

clientCalls.description: Let players' games join calls: Off (safe): only server scripts put players into calls, or a phone script that checks each join. On: any player could join any call; needed by phones that join calls from the player's game, such as lb-phone.

speaker.description: Phone loudspeaker: Phone scripts can turn a call's loudspeaker on: players standing next to the phone hear the other side.

speakerRadius.description: Loudspeaker reach: Players within this many metres of the phone hear the call.

speakerVolume.description: Loudspeaker volume: How loud others sound, in percent; players can change it for themselves.

speakerBidirectional.description: The call hears the people around: The other side of the call also hears the players standing next to the phone.

radioEffectBy.description: Effect taken over by: A running script that brings its own effect: ai-voice's effect stays off while it runs.

phoneEffectBy.description: Effect taken over by: A running script that brings its own effect: ai-voice's effect stays off while it runs.
